verdict.rationale: Brex documents a Transactions API for viewing transactions, accounts and statements, and an Expenses API that covers expenses and receipt upload with automatic matching. Authentication uses dashboard-generated user tokens with selectable data-access scopes, and Postman collections cover all the APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of an OAuth flow (only admin-generated scoped tokens are shown), evidence of retrieving or downloading receipts rather than just uploading them, and independent or hands-on corroboration (no published OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths).
